under anything more permissive.

Where it comes from
-------------------
The word, character and grammar lists: the official HSK 3.0 考试大纲, published
November 2025. Facts out of a published document.

The English meanings: adapted from CC-CEDICT
(https://www.mdbg.net/chinese/dictionary?page=cc-cedict), CC BY-SA 4.0. This
is why this data is share-alike.

The example sentences: largely from the Tatoeba Project (https://tatoeba.org),
CC BY 2.0 FR, plus sentences written for Gushi.

The selection, the pinyin, the tone numbers, the sense ordering and the
checking: Gushi.

The syllabus is the authority: where this data and the 考试大纲 disagree, the
syllabus is right, and we would like to hear about it: contact@gushi-chinese.online

The audio column
----------------
Free to play from gushi-chinese.online. NOT covered by this licence: the
recordings are synthesised speech and are not ours to relicense as a corpus.

The clips are served from https://gushi-chinese.online/audio/ and anyone may play them from there.
Please do not hotlink them from a product.
